name: cfcmt-bus-rule-confirmation-isolated-v1
missing_forward_neighbor: Use scheduled forward headway, as in the existing fixed rule
gate: Allow the next incremental cross-city stage only if the all-20-seed, six-cell equal-weight mean cost delta is at most -5 seconds per departed passenger, its paired training-seed CI95 upper endpoint is below zero, every source-by-demand cell mean cost delta is nonpositive, and every cell mean completion delta is at least -0.1 percentage points. Individual seed regressions are disclosed, not an automatic failure. A failed gate closes this confirmation without changing gain, seeds, or thresholds.
interpretation: Strong fixed-rule supplement on the previously analyzed v13 test days, not a wholly unseen target benchmark. Reuse all 20 fresh-seed fixed0250 policies without retraining, development selection, or test-driven coefficient selection. CI varies training initialization conditional on these five paired test days and the fixed source conditions; it does not cover new cities or a population of new days. Existing H2O+, fixed0300, shared_gated and duet comparisons remain descriptive and cannot replace the primary result. No data, checkpoints, or daily results are downloaded locally.
